integrity: The Fibonacci envelope is proved for all relevant spans; the accompanying checker performs finite boundary and examples checks and does not substitute for the infinite argument. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact extremal differences are established for even Lucas intervals. The entire difference distribution, uniqueness of maximum-attaining integers, and generalizations to other digit sets are not settled; the proof relies on the published exact Knott/natural recurrences and interval digit geometry. Originality has been checked against inspected accessible sources, not certified exhaustively.
title: Sharp Fibonacci excess of Knott over natural base-\(\varphi\) expansions on Lucas intervals
